mapper.select:
/* 할인유형조회 */ SELECT DISTINCT PL.SPRT_TP, --할인유형 (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM NMCP_CD_DTL@DL_MCP WHERE CD_GROUP_ID='F002' AND USE_YN='Y' AND PL.SPRT_TP=DTL_CD) AS SPRT_NM --할인유형명 FROM MSP_SALE_PLCY_MST PL, MSP_SALE_ORGN_MST ORG, MSP_SALE_PRDT_MST PRDT WHERE PL.CNFM_YN='Y' -- 결제 YN (필수) AND PL.SALE_PLCY_CD = ORG.SALE_PLCY_CD AND PL.SALE_PLCY_CD = PRDT.SALE_PLCY_CD AND ORG.SALE_PLCY_cD = PRDT.SALE_PLCY_CD AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') BETWEEN PL.SALE_STRT_DTTM AND PL.SALE_END_DTTM --판매기간 (필수)
AND PL.PLCY_TYPE_CD = #{plcyTypeCd} -- ???? : N , 온라인:O , 오프라인:M , 직영온라인 : D
AND PL.PLCY_SCTN_CD = #{reqBuyTypeCd.rateType} -- MM:단말(01),UU:유심(02)
AND ORG.ORGN_ID = #{orgnId} -- 조직코드
AND PRDT.PRDT_ID = #{prdtId} -- 단말기ID (자급제인 경우는 SKIP 처리)
AND PL.SALE_PLCY_CD = #{salePlcyCd}
AND PL.PRDT_SCTN_CD = #{prdtSctnCd} -- LTE,3G

SELECT RATE.RATE_CD , RATE.RATE_NM , RATE.PAY_CL_CD , RATE.DATA_TYPE --, RATE.FREE_CALL_CNT --, RATE.NW_IN_CALL_CNT --, RATE.NW_OUT_CALL_CNT --, RATE.FREE_SMS_CNT --, RATE.FREE_DATA_CNT --, '' AS RATEDESC --, '' AS KTRATENAME --, '' AS KTRATECODE --, '' AS AGREEMENT , NVL(DC_AMT, 0) AS DC_AMT , BASE_AMT , (BASE_AMT*0.1) VAT , NVL(SPEC.AGRM_TRM, 0) AGRM_TRM
, RATE.SERVICE_TYPE , RATE.JEHU_PROD_TYPE --요금제제휴처 , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM NMCP_CD_DTL@DL_MCP WHERE CD_GROUP_ID='JehuProdType' AND DTL_CD=RATE.JEHU_PROD_TYPE AND ROWNUM=1) AS JEHU_PROD_NM -- 요금제 제휴처명 FROM MSP_RATE_MST RATE , MSP_RATE_SPEC SPEC
WHERE 1=1 AND RATE.APPL_END_DT = '99991231' AND RATE.DATA_TYPE = #{prdtSctnCd} -- 'LTE' 5G적용 AND RATE.RATE_CD = SPEC.RATE_CD(+) AND SPEC.AGRM_TRM(+) = '0' AND SPEC.APPL_END_DTTM = '99991231235959'
AND RATE.RATE_CD IN
#{rate.prodId}
SELECT DECODE(ETC3,'Y',ETC4,ETC1) AS JOIN_PRICE , DECODE(ETC3,'Y',ETC5,ETC2) AS SIM_PRICE FROM CMN_GRP_CD_MST WHERE GRP_ID = 'RCP0053' AND CD_VAL = #{priceGubun} AND ROWNUM = 1
/* StoreUsimMapper.selectUsimDcamt */ SELECT DC_AMT FROM MSP_RATE_SPEC F WHERE RATE_CD =#{rateCd} AND AGRM_TRM ='0' AND ROWNUM =1 ORDER BY APPL_STRT_DTTM DESC

/*MspMapper.findMspSaleSubsdMst 상품의 판매금액관련 상세내역을 조회 한다.*/ SELECT SALE_PLCY_CD, --판매정책코드 RATE_CD, --요금제코드 PRDT_ID, --제품ID AGRM_TRM, --약정기간 OPER_TYPE, --업무유형 HNDST_AMT, --단말금액(VAT포함) SUBSD_AMT, --공시지원금(VAT포함) INST_AMT, --할부원금(VAT포함) INST_CMSN, --할부수수료(VAT포함) AGNCY_SUBSD_MAX, --대리점보조금MAX(VAT포함) AGNCY_SUBSD_AMT, --대리점보조금(VAT포함) SPRT_TP, --지원금유형 BASE_AMT, --기본료 DC_AMT, --기본할인금액 ADD_DC_AMT --추가할인금액
FROM MSP_SALE_SUBSD_MST WHERE 1=1 AND SALE_PLCY_CD = #{salePlcyCd} AND PRDT_ID = #{prdtId} --상품ID AND RATE_CD = #{rateCd} --요금제코드 AND AGRM_TRM = #{agrmTrm} --약정기간 AND OPER_TYPE = #{operTypeCd} --가입유형 (NAC3 , MNP3 , HDN3) AND SPRT_TP =#{sprtTp} --할인유형 (단말 KD , 요금 PM) AND OLD_YN = #{oldYn} --중고여부 AND ORGN_ID = #{orgnId} --조직코드
